card.name: Duration after a repeating dose schedule
card.fires_on: The word "for" right after a frequency phrase like "daily", "every week" or "once every month", just before a length of treatment. Also "days" in "for 5 consecutive days".

modes.label: "for" after frequency
modes.description: The word "for" follows a recurring-dose phrase and introduces how long dosing lasts.
modes.example: repeated daily<< for>> 5 days. Repeat cycle every

modes.label: "days" in a course length
modes.description: The word "days" ends a count of treatment days within a cycle.
modes.example: daily for 5 consecutive<< days>> of a 28-day cycle.

card.writes: It seems to prepare a number and time unit for the length of a treatment course.
card.plain: It marks the spot in a dosing schedule where the text says how long a repeated dose goes on.
